image_description: A male black grouse (blackcock) in a display posture on grassy ground. The bird has glossy black plumage with visible iridescence, prominent red eyebrow combs, and its tail is fanned out in a lyre shape revealing white undertail coverts. The legs appear feathered down to the feet.
